name: The Tower of Five Hearts
source:
Tsukiware’s second major title, Tower of Five Hearts, is a yuri tale of several maids in service to their princess, all hoping to become her bride for the sake of their respective kingdoms. With artwork by Ryle, you can enjoy fox girls, dog girls, lamia, bunny girls, and catgirls all competing for one lucky woman’s hand in marriage.

From [url=http://blog.mangagamer.org/2017/08/11/otakon-2017-announcements/]MangaGamer[/url]
